day_shape: 119 items: IDF demolishes Ali Taher tunnel complex in southern Lebanon with 1,100 tons of explosives and kills Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade commander, State Dept and OFAC roll out fresh Iran-proxy sanctions, Houthis advance on Bab el-Mandeb islands, and UN Security Council splits again over Iran snapback.

threads.label: Ali Taher tunnel demolition in south Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF demolished Hezbollah's 5+ km underground complex beneath the Ali Taher Ridge using more than 1,100 tons of explosives, releasing footage of tunnels stocked with Iranian-made rockets, UAVs and anti-tank missiles. Netanyahu and Katz confirmed the operation; Iran International linked it to the Islamabad memorandum naming Lebanon.

threads.label: Khan Younis Brigade commander killed in Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF confirmed killing Muhammad Yazouri, commander of Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade, alongside a company commander and a further operative in an overnight airstrike in southern Gaza. A separate strike in central Gaza killed Hamas operative Farah Hamed, while officials at the MEAD conference described a Gaza reconstruction plan involving Hamas disarmament as stalled.

threads.label: US sanctions on Iran-proxy financial networks
threads.summary: The State Department announced action under Operation Economic Outcast against Kata'ib Hizballah, Hezbollah and networks across Iraq, Lebanon, the UAE and Turkey, while OFAC published Iran-related General Licenses CC and DD in the Federal Register. Treasury Secretary Bessent said a large bank would be sanctioned next week as economic pressure on Tehran continues.

threads.label: Houthi advance on Bab el-Mandeb and UNSC Yemen session
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported Yemeni government forces withdrew from Perim island in the Bab el-Mandeb after Houthi entry, with IRIB claiming seizure of Hanis al-Kubra and al-Sughra islands and advance into Dhubab. The UN Special Envoy told the Security Council Yemen has entered a 'new, more dangerous phase', with the UK condemning the Houthi decision to resume conflict; Defa Press claimed bin Salman twice asked Trump to strike the Houthis.

threads.label: UN Security Council Iran nuclear file and diplomacy
threads.summary: The Security Council debated the 1737 Iran Sanctions Committee with members divided over whether snapback sanctions have taken effect, while Iran's UN chargé Dehghani wrote to the French Council presidency calling fresh nuclear accusations non-technical. Netanyahu vowed Iran would not obtain nuclear weapons on his watch after Trump said Tehran was attempting to rebuild capabilities; Gulf foreign ministers are reportedly planning to meet Araghchi on a Hormuz shipping arrangement.

threads.label: Pezeshkian to BRICS and Iran diplomatic outreach
threads.summary: President Pezeshkian departed for India to attend the 18th BRICS summit, framing it as a forum for countering unilateralism and non-dollar investment. Foreign Minister Araghchi held calls with South Korea's foreign minister and Pakistan army chief Asim Munir, and met the parliamentary economic commission.

threads.label: Regime messaging on Trump war costs and AI targeting
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press amplified Politico, Al-Jazeera and Atlantic framings that Trump's Iran war has cost roughly $1,650 per US household and threatens Republican midterm prospects, with Araghchi thanking the acting US Navy Secretary for admitting Iran 'levelled' the Fifth Fleet HQ in Bahrain. Iran International reported Anthropic said Iran-linked accounts used Claude for propaganda, US naval targeting and profiling of Israelis and Jewish diaspora.
